details: auclean reads /proc/1/cgroup, /proc/self/mountinfo and /sys/fs/cgroup to detect containers and sandboxes, then searches PATH plus /root/.local/bin, /root/.cargo/bin and /root/.bun/bin for tools like curl, nc, ssh, docker and kubectl. It lists and write-tests several system directories and connects over HTTPS to auclean-cdn.alcoholpepsi.workers.dev.
